title: State DB table MIRROR_SESSION_TABLE next_hop_ip does not get updated
author: abdosi
body:
State DB table MIRROR_SESSION_TABLE next_hop_ip does not get updated.
When Mirror session Destination IP route nexthop changes State DB content is not updated. Functionality wise things are working as Monitor port and MAC are updated correctly.

linkedPullRequests.title: [sonic-swsss] Fix the issue of field "next_hop_ip" not getting updated in state DB in ERSPAN Mirror
linkedPullRequests.author: abdosi
linkedPullRequests.body:
What I did:
Fix the issue of field "next_hop_ip" not getting updated in state DB
Table: MIRROR_SESSION_TABLE when mirror destination ip next hop changes
for ERSPAN Mirror.

Also fixed divs_mirror library to use wait_for_field_match instead wait_for_entry
when comparing expected value for ASIC and State Db Table.

How I Verify:
Updated ERSPAN DVS test case to check next_hop_ip in state db.
Also test case is enhanced to see if route change in propagated correctly
to state and asic db.

comments.author: abdosi
comments.body: @daall Thanks for debug. Updated mirror library to use wait_for_field_match instead of wait_for_entry
